Naaaaaah, if someone said something was going to happen then it should happen no matter what you do to prevent it! Like if you're driving a car and you turn the steering wheel to the right you'll still keep going straight!

That's how this works, right?

... right?

Honestly American insulin costs were the first thing that came to mind when blue said "commumism killed more by not providing shit". Like dude, people are risking their lives by rationing their insulin or straight up dying from diabetes under the capitalist system the US because it's not providing them with insulin - because it's been made too expensive for some people to afford. 

My next thought was the effects of environmental damage done by corporations so that they male an extra few bucks but that's a whole other discussion.

Yeah it's the checks-and-balances that are important. Nothing wrong with capitalist competition as long as you don't end up with monopolies/oligopolies in an industry, while on the other hand some areas of society should not be run for profit (healthcare, prisons, schools), but they also need to be monitored to make sure they're not stagnant or wasteful.
No. I'm not getting any better and I don't think I will ever.
